headline: Executive order lets the US freeze property of certain people tied to serious human rights abuses by Iran's government.
what_it_does: This order allows the US government to block, or freeze, property and interests in property in the United States belonging to certain people connected to serious human rights abuses by the government of Iran. Blocked property generally cannot be transferred, paid out, or used. The title says the order also takes other actions, but no summary was provided to explain them.

who_it_affects.group: People linked to human rights abuses by Iran's government
who_it_affects.how: Their property under US control can be frozen.
They generally may not deal in property that has been blocked under the order.
